name: grant-match-nl
description: Public funding programs that could fit a Newfoundland and Labrador small business, every fact quoted from the program's own page.

scripts.dev:worker: npm run build:data && npm --prefix worker run dev
scripts.test:worker: npm run build:data && npm --prefix worker test
scripts.test:app: npm run build:data && playwright test -c app/playwright.config.mjs
scripts.test: npm run check:data && npm run test:core && npm run test:worker && npm run test:app
scripts.dev: echo 'Two terminals: npm run dev:worker (API on 127.0.0.1:7402), then npm run dev:app (app on http://127.0.0.1:7401)'
